if(NOT HC32_PORTABLE)
    set(PORT_SOURCES lvgl_new.cpp lv_port.cpp lv_port_disp.cpp)
elseif(PORTABLE_SPI)
    set(PORT_SOURCES lv_port_disp.cpp)
elseif(PORTABLE_DISPLAY)
    set(PORT_SOURCES lvgl_new.cpp)
endif()
add_library(hc32_${HC32_PREFIX}lvgl_port OBJECT ${PORT_SOURCES})
add_library(hc32::${HC32_PREFIX}lvgl_port ALIAS hc32_${HC32_PREFIX}lvgl_port)
target_include_directories(hc32_${HC32_PREFIX}lvgl_port PUBLIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
target_link_libraries(hc32_${HC32_PREFIX}lvgl_port PUBLIC lvgl::lvgl
    hc32::${HC32_PREFIX}config_headers ${HC32_PORT})
if(NOT HC32_PORTABLE OR PORTABLE_SPI)
    target_link_libraries(hc32_${HC32_PREFIX}lvgl_port PUBLIC hc32::${HC32_PREFIX}panel)
endif()
